title: Connect Claude, Cursor, or ChatGPT to Frigade Engage
summary: We're running it back this week! Frigade Engage now has an MCP server. It allows you to connect Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, or ChatGPT to your workspace and ask about your flows, collections, surveys
body_markdown:
We're running it back this week! Frigade Engage now has an MCP server. It allows you to connect Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, or ChatGPT to your workspace and ask about your flows, collections, surveys, insights, and users in plain language. For instance, you can ask it about your survey results or how users are interacting with your announcement flow.


To set it up, open Integrations in the dashboard and choose Frigade MCP Server. It shows the server URL for your region and the steps for each client.
